title: Manyhands JSON v1 pull-request promotion mutation
description: The data of a result of document promote in a pull-request repository, or of an operation resume that continued one: a branch record that finished, whatever way. Nothing of it reaches primary, so it has no integration, cleanup or made-ready report. It carries the data in an ok, already_applied or remote_branch_deleted answer, in the recovery_required answer of a record whose child ended on history_unresolved, and in the answer of a record whose context is gone. A prepare that is blocked answers with the lifecycle's blocked data instead, a prepare of a document the primary already holds answers already_applied with no data, and a child of the record that stops carries the synchronization's own. It holds IDs and fixed categories: no title, body or path.

publication.description: How the document's branch reached the remote: published when this record's context child pushed it, current when the remote held it already. Null when no child completed.

primary_holds.description: Whether the primary already holds the document, so that there is nothing to open a pull request for.

pull_request.description: Where to open the pull request, from the link record. Null when the document has none.

blockers.description: What stands in the way, as a blocked prepare names it. Empty otherwise; history_unresolved for a record whose child ended on it.
